title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki CheckUser Extension. It involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the module buildUserElement.js. The flaw affects versions from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.8.
